blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Knowing that a pedestrian is occluded is useful to a robot even when the detector cannot recover the hidden pixels, but occlusion estimators are normally trained on occlusion annotations that deployment settings rarely have. We show that occlusion can be read off two distance estimates a camera-only pipeline already computes. Apparent height is largely unchanged by occlusion, because the detected box still spans the whole person; monocular metric depth is pulled toward the occluder, because the nearest surface inside the box is what a depth map reports. Only their ordering matters, so no focal length, stature, or depth scale is needed, provided the depth model's error is close to a pure gain, a condition that can be checked without labels. The score detects heavy occlusion on KITTI with AUC 0.909 (0.888 over all annotated pedestrians, including those the detector misses), requires no training and no occlusion labels, and is not a proxy for range: within fixed distance bands it holds AUC 0.894-0.925 while true distance alone sits near chance. On synthetic CARLA scenes with measured visibility it reaches 0.819, against 0.644 for distance alone. We arrived here after measuring three standard architectural responses to occlusion, depth fusion, occlusion-simulating augmentation, and attention, none of which improved detection outside its training distribution in the configurations we tested, and after finding that a detector trained on German roads loses half its accuracy on self-annotated street scenes in Lagos, Nigeria. Signals that need no local annotation are worth more in settings that benchmarks do not represent.
blocks.zh: 明知行人被吞噬,即使探测器无法恢复隐藏的像素,对机器人还是有用的,但隔离估计器通常会接受部署设置很少有的隔离说明的培训. 我们显示,闭塞可以读取两个距离 估计一个只摄像头的管道已经计算。 外观高度基本上没有被隐蔽现象所改变,因为检测到的盒子仍然横跨整个人;单光度度量深度被拉向隐蔽器,因为盒子内最近的表面是深度图报告的内容. 只有他们的订购事项,所以不需要焦距,身高,或深度尺度,只要深度模型的误差接近纯增益,这个条件可以在没有标签的情况下检查. 分数用AUC 0.909探测到KITTI上的重隐蔽(包括探测器失守者在内,所有注解行人均使用0.888),不需要训练,也不使用隐蔽标签,也不代表射程:在固定距离带内,它持有AUC 0.894-0.925 而真正的距离 独自坐近机会。 在人工合成的CARLA场景中,仅距离就达到了0.819,而距离仅为0.644。 我们来到这里之前测量了三种标准建筑反应 对隔离,深度聚变, 隔离模拟增强, 和注意, 没有一个改进的探测 在其训练分布之外 我们测试的配置, 不需要本地注释的信号在基准不代表的环境下更值得使用。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Robots need to know what is around them, and a camera is the cheapest way to sense it. People and
objects are often only partly visible, and this occlusion is the dominant failure condition for
pedestrian detection in cluttered environments [1]. A robot does not
always need to recover the hidden pixels. Often it is enough to know that a detection is
occluded, so it can widen an uncertainty estimate or shorten a planning horizon.
blocks.zh:
机器人需要知道周围是什么,而相机是最便宜的感知方式. 人民与
物体往往只有部分可见,而这种被封入是主要失效条件。
在杂乱的环境中进行行人探测 [1] (中文(简体) ). 机器人不会
总是需要恢复隐藏的像素. 通常只要知道一个探测器
被忽略,因此可以扩大不确定性估计或缩短规划地平线.

blocks.en:
Most prior work addresses occlusion by changing the detector, fusing separately estimated depth with
the RGB image [2–4], simulating occlusion during training by masking parts of objects [5–8], or
adding attention that re-weights features toward visible parts [9,10]. Designing
for a low-cost robot, we measured all three; none improved detection outside its training
distribution in the configurations we tested, and depth fusion hurt accuracy even in-distribution,
matching a known limit of monocular depth models [11,12]. A detector trained on this benchmark data
also lost about half its accuracy on 350 self-annotated Lagos frames.
blocks.zh:
大多数前期工作都通过改变探测器解决隔离问题,将估计的深度分别与
RGB 图像 [2–4],模拟在训练期间用遮盖物体的部位来遮掩[5–8],或
增加注意,重新对可见部分进行加权[9,10]。 设计
对于一个低成本的机器人,我们测量了所有三个;除了训练外,没有任何改进的探测
在我们测试的配置中分布 深度聚变会伤害精度 即使是分散
匹配已知的单体深度模型限制[11,12]。 训练有素的探测器
在350个自行说明的拉各斯相框上也失去了大约一半的准确度.

blocks.en:
Our depth branch failed as a detection input, but that failure is what our approach is built on. A
depth map reports how far away the nearest visible surface is at each point. Inside an occluded
pedestrian’s box, that nearest surface is usually the occluder, not the person
behind it, so the depth value read is pulled toward the occluder’s distance. Apparent
height is unaffected, since the box still spans the whole person. The two cues
move in opposite directions under occlusion, so their disagreement is a direct readout of it,
computed from two numbers the pipeline already produces. Contributions. A training-free,
label-free occlusion signal from this disagreement, validated with a distance-band check that rules
out range as a confound and with tests of each link in its mechanism; and a controlled comparison of
depth fusion, augmentation, and attention across 81 checkpoints, together with a self-collected Lagos
evaluation set measuring the detector transfer gap that motivates a training-free signal.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Depth without LiDAR. MV3D-style LiDAR fusion [2] remains the accuracy reference but is hard
to justify on low-cost platforms. MiDaS [3] predicts only relative depth, with no fixed scale;
Depth Anything V2 [4] recovers absolute scale, and we use its outdoor variant, fine-tuned on
synthetic Virtual KITTI rather than LiDAR-supervised frames, so evaluating on KITTI leaks no measured
depth. Monocular depth decoders also blur values across occlusion boundaries, since a convolution
kernel mixes information across surfaces in its receptive field [11], and a concurrent study
reports depth can make an RGB-D detector perform worse than RGB alone [12].
blocks.zh:
深度没有LiDAR. MV3D-风格的LiDAR聚变 [2] 仍为准确性参考,但很难
在低成本平台上说明理由。 米达斯 [3] 仅预测相对深度,没有固定尺度;
深度 Anything V2 [4] 回收绝对尺度,我们使用它的室外变体,微调在
合成虚拟 KITTI 而不是LiDAR 监督框架,因此在 KITTI 上评价未测量
深处。 单相深度解码器也模糊了 隔绝边界的值,因为一个进化
内核在其可接受领域将不同表面的信息相混合[11],并同时进行研究
报告深度可以使RGB-D探测器的性能比仅RGB[12]更差.

blocks.en:
Occlusion robustness vs. occlusion estimation. Augmentation,
single-region masking [5,6], multi-patch hiding [7], grid erasure [8], and attention that
reweights features toward occluded pedestrians [9,10] all try to make a detector perform
better despite occlusion. Neither tells you whether a specific detection is actually occluded.
Stereo methods detect occlusion directly from left–right disparity inconsistency [13]. MonoLoco
[14] comes closest, but treats wider uncertainty on occluded cases as incidental rather than
validated, and never checks whether the effect is occlusion or just distance. Bi-box regression also
estimates occlusion but needs paired visible and full-body labels [15]. We instead treat the
disagreement between two distance estimates as the signal itself, training-free and label-free.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 System Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 系统概览

blocks.en:
Figure 1 shows the full pipeline. An RGB frame enters a
YOLOv8 detector [16,17] (YOLOv8x in our evaluation), producing bounding boxes
for each detected pedestrian. Those boxes feed two parallel distance
estimators, an apparent-height module and a Depth Anything V2 [4] branch
reading the nearest surface inside each box. Their disagreement produces a
scalar occlusion score passed to the planner. LiDAR ground truth is used only
for evaluation; the runtime path is entirely camera-based. We arrived at this
design after the three model-side responses to occlusion, measured across 81
checkpoints (Section 4.6 ), failed to transfer in the configurations
tested, which turned the
question toward why depth failed as a detector input.

blocks.zh: 3.2.2 单体 计量深度估计

blocks.en: The second distance cue is obtained using a frozen Depth Anything V2 outdoor metric depth model. For each detected pedestrian, z dep = k ⋅ d min z_{\mathrm{dep}}=k\cdot d_{\mathrm{min}} , where d min d_{\mathrm{min}} is the minimum depth value in the box and k k is a scale factor fitted on fully-visible instances, used only by the calibrated read-outs of Appendix B . Unlike apparent height, z dep z_{\mathrm{dep}} is sensitive to occlusion, since a closer occluder’s surface can dominate that minimum, pulling the estimate toward the camera. Low percentiles, robust to a single erroneous pixel, perform as well or better (Appendix C ); our released implementation uses the 5th percentile.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: We train YOLOv8n and YOLOv8x on KITTI [18] and CityPersons [19] using byte-identical settings and standard train/validation/test splits. Three seeds are used where confidence intervals are reported and one where marked, giving 81 evaluated checkpoints. Occlusion augmentation is applied only during training and only when more than half of the ground-truth pedestrian remains visible. We report mAP@0.5 by KITTI occlusion level.
blocks.zh: 在KITTI[18]和CityPersons[19]上进行YOLOv8n和YOLOv8x的训练,使用字节-同声设置和标准列车/验证/测试分出. 在报告信任间隔时使用3个种子,在有标记时使用3个种子,给81个经过评价的检查站。 只有在培训期间,并且只有在半数以上的地上真人仍然露出面时,才适用闭塞加固。 我们报告mAP@0.

blocks.en: KITTI labels pedestrians fully visible (0), partly (1) or largely occluded (2), or unknown (3); heavy is 2–3 and any is 1–3, each against visible. The score is evaluated on 1,941 detections from three YOLOv8x seeds, matched to 682 distinct test pedestrians by greedy IoU ≥ \geq 0.5. AUC measures whether an occluded pedestrian is ranked above a fully-visible one; since a pedestrian contributes up to three rows, 95% intervals bootstrap pedestrians (2,000 resamples).
blocks.zh: KITTI给行人贴上完全可见的标签(0),部分(1)或基本被占用的(2),或不明的(3);重为2–3,任何一为1–3,每为对可见. 得分通过3个YOLOv8x种子的1,941个检测结果来评价,与贪婪的IoU ≥\ geq 0.5的682个不同的测试行人对应. AUC测量被困行人是否排名在全能行人之上;由于行人贡献了最多三行,95%的间隔靴子圈行人(2,000个复标).

blocks.en: 4.2 Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 结果

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows the mechanism on one KITTI frame. For the visible pedestrian, apparent height and depth agree (10.5 m vs. 10.7 m). For the occluded pedestrian, the nearest surface belongs to the occluder, apparent height gives 20.8 m while depth gives 13.6 m. The resulting 34% disagreement reduces the score to 0.79 of the scene median.
blocks.zh: 图2显示一个KITTI框架中的机制。 对于可见行人,外观高度和深度一致(10.5米对10.7米). 对于被困行人来说,最近的地表属于被困行人,明显的高度为20.8米,而深度为13.6米. 由此而来34%的分歧将得分降至场景中位数的0.79分.

blocks.en: Figure 2: One KITTI frame showing the proposed cue. The visible pedestrian’s nearest surface is their own and the two distance estimates agree; for the occluded pedestrian, depth reads the nearer occluder and the estimates diverge by 34%.
blocks.zh: 图2:显示拟议提示的一个KITTI框架。 可见行人最近的地表是他们自己的,两个距离估计一致;对于行人来说,深度读取了更接近的行人,估计值相差了34%。

blocks.en: 4.3 Occlusion Detection and Distance Control
blocks.zh: 4.3 闭塞探测和远程控制

blocks.en: The score reaches AUC 0.909 for heavy occlusion and 0.826 for any occlusion on matched detections, and 0.775 for partly occluded pedestrians alone. The detector misses 27% of largely occluded pedestrians (3% of visible ones), so matched detections favor the easier occluded cases; scoring all 709 annotated test pedestrians with annotated boxes, no detector involved, gives 0.888 [0.852, 0.921].
blocks.zh: 该分分数为AUC 0.909分的重闭塞和0.826分的相匹配探测器上的任何闭塞,而仅部分闭塞行人则有0.775分. 探测器错过了27%的基本上被占用行人(3%的可见行人),因此匹配的探测偏好更方便的被占用行人;所有709名附加注释的测试行人都有附加注释的盒子,没有涉及探测器,给出了0.888分[0.852分,0.921分].

blocks.en: A distance confound is unlikely. Occluded pedestrians are farther away on average (16.9 m vs. 13.2 m), but within fixed distance bands true distance falls to near chance (AUC 0.457–0.594), while the proposed score remains at 0.894–0.925 for heavy occlusion (Table 1 ). The 5–10 m band rests on only 10 distinct heavily occluded pedestrians, so its interval is wide. The full breakdown, for any, partial and heavy occlusion, is in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 4.4 Formulation, Depth Source and Mechanism
blocks.zh: 4.4 拟订、深度来源和机制

blocks.en: The calibration-free ranking performs identically to calibrated alternatives (0.909 vs. 0.908) and requires metric rather than ordinal depth: MiDaS’s relative output reverses the ranking (Appendix B ). The result survives each test of its mechanism we could construct (Appendix C ): swapping predicted and annotated boxes for either cue moves heavy AUC by at most 0.010, low percentiles in place of the minimum give 0.910–0.921, and box shifts of up to 4 px give 0.904–0.907.
blocks.zh: 无校正的排名与校正的替代品相同(0.909 vs. 0.908),并且需要公制而不是正则深度:MiDAS的相对输出倒置了排名(附录B. 其结果是在我们能够构建的每一次机制测试(附录C ):将预测和附加说明的盒子换成最多为0.010个的重AUC移动,取而代之的是低百分位数,最小值为0.910–0.921,最大为4个px的箱位转移为0.904–0.907。

blocks.en: 4.5 Beyond KITTI, and Runtime
blocks.zh: 4.5 超越KITTI和运行时间

blocks.en: On 573 synthetic CARLA frames (3,293 pedestrians), with visibility measured by re-rendering without occluders, the score reaches AUC 0.819 [0.801, 0.834] against 0.644 for distance alone, beating distance in every band (Appendix E ). CARLA’s boxes are oracle and its depth checkpoint was chosen on CARLA ground-truth depth, so this tests the depth mechanism under a change of domain and camera height, not the full pipeline. The score itself costs about 0.3 ms per frame on a laptop CPU; the depth network dominates (Appendix F ).
blocks.zh: 在573个合成CARLA相框上(3,293个行人),以不穿行者重新投放来测量能见度,得分达到AUC 0.819 [0.801,0.834],而单距离为0.644,每段的出击距离(Appendix E. CARLA的箱子是甲骨文的,它的深度检查点是在CARLA的地上真实的深度上选择的,因此在域和相机高度的变化下测试了深度机制,而不是整个管道. 得分本身在笔记本电脑CPU上每帧成本约为0.3ms;深度网络占主导地位(Appendix F.

blocks.en: 4.6 Model-Side Alternatives and Lagos Transfer
blocks.zh: 4.6 模式-单一替代品和拉各斯转让

blocks.en: Table 6 (Appendix D ) reports three model-side interventions. With three YOLOv8x seeds, augmentation improves hard KITTI cases by + 0.041 +0.041 mAP50 but not CityPersons, and MiDaS depth fusion reduces accuracy. The DAv2 fusion and POPAM rows are single YOLOv8n runs; they record what those configurations did, not that the interventions generally fail.
blocks.zh: 表6(附录D)报告了三项示范方面的干预措施。 有3个YOLOv8x种子,增强能将硬KITTI的病例改进为+0.041+0.041 mAP50,但不是CityPersons,而MiDAS深度聚变会降低精度. Dav2聚变和POPAM行是单YOLOv8n跑道;它们记录了这些配置所做的,而不是干预一般失败.

blocks.en: On 350 self-annotated Lagos frames (Table 7 ), a KITTI-trained detector drops from 0.8809 to 0.4482 mAP50, while the CityPersons-trained baseline reaches 0.7356, a + 0.2873 +0.2873 difference on identical frames. The datasets differ in size, density, diversity, geography, camera and annotation protocol, so this shows only that the CityPersons-trained model transfers better. It evaluates the detector, not the score: the Lagos annotations have no occlusion labels.
blocks.zh: 在350个自行说明的拉各斯相框(表7)上,KITTI所训练的探测器从0.8809降至0.4482 mAP50,而CityPersons所训练的基线则达到0.7356,在相同的相框上相差0.2873+0.2873. 数据集在大小,密度,多样性,地理学,相机和注释协议上各有不同,因此这只表明CityPersons训练有素的模型传输更好. 它评价的是探测器,而不是分数:拉各斯说明书没有封口标签.

blocks.en: Table 3 compares three read-outs of the cue disagreement, referenced in Section 4.4. The ranking score and the signed ratio are monotone and perform identically, so removing f y f_{y} , S S , and k k costs nothing. The absolute difference performs worse and collapses once the depth scale is perturbed 25% high, confirming that ranking, not magnitude, is what survives calibration drift. Depth reads farther than apparent height for 44% of fully-visible pedestrians but only 3% of heavily occluded ones, so the direction of the disagreement is itself informative and taking its magnitude discards that.

blocks.en: Depth offset. Eq. 2 predicts that an additive depth offset b b turns the score partly into a range measure. Adding a synthetic offset to d min d_{\mathrm{min}} reproduces this. At b = 0 b=0 the score is nearly uncorrelated with distance among visible pedestrians ( ρ = − 0.07 \rho=-0.07 ). At b = + 2 b=+2 and + 4 +4 m, ρ = − 0.61 \rho=-0.61 and − 0.81 -0.81 , and the weakest within-band heavy AUC falls from 0.894 to 0.839 and 0.800. Overall AUC falls more slowly, to 0.876 at + 4 +4 m, which is why within-band AUC, not overall AUC, is the criterion to report. The correlation needs no occlusion labels, so it is a deployment check for any new depth checkpoint or camera mounting. The calibration-free property holds on KITTI because this checkpoint’s offset there is negligible. It is not a general guarantee: on CARLA (Appendix E ) the depth checkpoint used has a substantial offset.

blocks.en: Appendix C Mechanism Checks
blocks.zh: 附录C 机制 检查

blocks.en: A high AUC does not by itself show that the mechanism in the Introduction produces it. Table 5 tests each link on the same KITTI detections and depth maps.
blocks.zh: 高级哥伦比亚联合自卫军本身并不表明导言中的机制产生这种机制。 表5在相同的KITTI探测和深度图上测试每个链接.

blocks.en: Detector boxes. If occluded boxes shrank, z app z_{\mathrm{app}} would inflate and the score could read localization error. The median predicted-to-annotated box-height ratio is 0.99–1.00 at every occlusion level, but 15% of largely occluded predicted boxes are more than 10% short (1% of visible), mostly low-confidence detections. Swapping either ingredient between predicted and annotated boxes changes heavy AUC by at most 0.010. Scoring all 709 annotated pedestrians with annotated boxes, no detector involved, gives 0.888. It is lower than 0.909 because the detector misses 27% of largely occluded pedestrians (10% of partly occluded, 3% of visible), so matched detections favor the easier occluded cases.
blocks.zh: 探测器盒 如果默认的框缩小, z app z_{\ mathrm{ app}} }}会膨胀, 分数可以读取本地化错误 。 中位数的预测-注解箱高比为0.99–1.00,每封装水平,但15%的被基本封闭的预测箱短于10%(1%可见),大部分是低信心检测. 将预想和附加说明的盒子之间的任何成分均以0.010的速度改变重型AUC。 将所有709名注有注释的行人用注有注释的盒子进行分解,没有涉及探测器,给出了0.888. 它低于0.909, 因为探测器错过了27%的基本上被占用的行人(10%部分被占用,3%可见),

blocks.en: The minimum operator. Low percentiles perform as well as the minimum or better (0.910–0.921), and the signal fades only toward the median (0.859), where the occluder no longer dominates. Shrinking the box helps, growing it admits ground and background, and shifts of up to 4 px barely matter: the near part of the depth distribution carries the effect, not one pixel.
blocks.zh: 最小操作员。 低百分位数的性能和最低或更高(0.910–0.921),信号只向中位数(0.859)淡出,而其中的占地者不再占主导地位。 冲出这个盒子有帮助,生长它会吸收地上和背景,而转动到4个px几乎不重要:深度分布的相近部分带有效果,而不是一个像素.

blocks.en: Other confounds. Excluding truncated pedestrians raises heavy AUC to 0.913. Stature varies with log-s.d. 0.064 among visible pedestrians, against a median log-score shift of 0.37 under heavy occlusion. The score is weaker on low-confidence detections (0.867 in the lowest confidence tercile, 0.903 in the middle; the top tercile has too few heavy cases to score). Pose is unlabeled in KITTI and untested.
blocks.zh: 其他的混乱。 不包括短道速滑行人,使AUC的重量提高到0.913. 在可见行人中,Stature与log-s.d. 0.064不同,相较于重隔离下中位数的log-score偏移为0.37. 在低信任度检测上得分较弱(最低信任度为0.867分,中间为0.903分;最高信任度的重例太少而不能得分). Pose在KITTI中没有标签,也没有经过测试.

blocks.en: Appendix E Out-of-Domain Validation on CARLA
blocks.zh: 附录E CARLA域外验证

blocks.en: Data and labels. We render 573 frames in CARLA 0.9.16 (Towns 01–05) from a simulated low-mounted robot camera (0.152 m above the ground, 1280 × \times 720), giving 3,293 pedestrians. Every frame is rendered twice, once with occluding actors removed; a pedestrian’s visibility is the ratio of their instance-mask pixel counts between the two renders, so labels are measured rather than annotated. A pedestrian with visibility below 0.8 is occluded (1,493 occluded, 1,800 visible). Depth is Depth Anything V2 Metric-Indoor-Large from RGB alone.
blocks.zh: 数据与标签. 我们在CARLA 0.9.16(Towns 01-05)中,用模拟低载机器人相机(地上0.152米,1280x\times 720)制造了573帧相机,给出3 293名行人. 每个相框被制成两次,一次被取出一副相片;行人能见度是他们两个相片之间的实例-面具像素计数比例,所以标签是测量的而不是注释的. 有能见度低于0.8的行人被占用(1,493个能见度,1,800个能见度). 深度是深度 Anything V2 Metric-Indoor-Large 单从 RGB.

blocks.en: What is and is not held out. The score formulation, the use of full-extent boxes, and the 5th-percentile depth statistic were fixed from KITTI before CARLA was evaluated, and no occlusion label was used to choose anything. The depth checkpoint was chosen using CARLA data: the outdoor checkpoint reads distances several times too far at this camera height, which we found by comparing predicted with ground-truth depth. CARLA supplies oracle full-extent boxes, so these results isolate the depth mechanism from detector behavior; the KITTI analysis of Appendix C covers the detector.
blocks.zh: 何等为而无所执. 分数配方,全宽箱的使用,以及第5百分位深度统计在CARLA评价前从KITTI中被确定,没有使用隔离标签来选择任何东西. 深度检查点是使用 CARLA 数据选择的: 室外检查点读取相机高度的相距数倍之多, CARLA提供甲骨文全能箱,因此这些结果将深度机制与探测器行为隔离;附录C的KITTI分析涵盖了探测器.

blocks.en: Results. The score reaches AUC 0.819 [0.801, 0.834] (frame bootstrap) against 0.644 for distance alone, and beats distance in every band (Table 8 ). Performance falls with range because the indoor checkpoint saturates beyond about 8 m, and at this camera height its depth error has a substantial offset, the case Eq. 2 warns about. The KITTI and CARLA results have complementary weaknesses: KITTI has real imagery but coarse human labels, CARLA has exact labels but synthetic imagery and oracle boxes.
blocks.zh: 结果。 单程得分达到AUC 0.819 [0.801,0.834] (帧靴子),而单程得分为0.644,并比分为每段(表8. 性能随范围而下降,因为室内检查站饱和度超过约8米,在此相机高度下,其深度误差有大幅相抵,案例Eq. 2警告. KITTI和CARLA的结果有互补的弱点:KITTI有真实的图像但粗糙的人类标签,CARLA有确切的标签但合成图像和甲骨文盒.

blocks.en: Appendix F Runtime
blocks.zh: 附录F 运行时间

blocks.en: Table 9 reports median per-frame latency on 40 KITTI test frames on a laptop CPU (Intel Core i7-8665U, 4 threads, eager PyTorch, fp32, no GPU), with a YOLOv8n detector at 640 px and Depth Anything V2 Metric-Outdoor-Small. The depth network keeps the frame’s aspect ratio, so a 518 px short side is a 518 × \times 1722 input on KITTI. The score itself, a box percentile and a product, costs about 0.3 ms; the depth network is 94–98% of the pipeline. A smaller depth input is about 5 × \times faster, but on this small sample the resulting scores rank-correlate with the full-size ones at only 0.68, so its occlusion AUC is untested. We have not measured embedded hardware, compiled or quantized depth networks, or lighter depth models, and make no real-time claim.
blocks.zh: 表9报告膝上型CPU(Intel Core i7-8665U,4个线程,渴望的PyTorch,fp32,无GPU)上40个KITTI测试帧的每帧潜伏度中位数,其YOLOv8n探测器为640px,深度Anything V2门外-Small. 深度网络保持了帧的外观比,因此一个518 px短的一面是518 ×\times 1722 introduction on KITTI. 得分本身,一盒百分位和一盒产品,成本约为0.3毫秒;深度网络为管道的94-98%. 一个更小的深度输入大约是5×\时速更快,但是在这个小样本中,所产生的分数与全尺寸分数的分数只有0.68分,因此其被忽略的AUC没有经过测试. 我们没有测量嵌入式硬件, 编译或量化的深度网络, 或更轻的深度模型, 没有实时的声称。

blocks.en: Appendix G Implementation and Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录G 执行和评价详情

blocks.en: KITTI is split 5,236/1,122/1,123 and CityPersons 2,432/521/522 for train/validation/test. Three seeds are used for every configuration where a confidence interval is reported; single-seed results are marked † \dagger in Table 6 , giving 81 evaluated checkpoints in total. All models train with SGD (lr0 0.0013, lrf 0.123, weight decay 0.0054) for 150 epochs, batch size 32, patience 20, at 640 px. Occlusion augmentation is applied only during training, and only when more than half of the ground-truth pedestrian remains visible. Depth Anything V2’s metric output is clipped to 0–80 m. The occlusion score is evaluated on 1,941 matched KITTI test detections (682 pedestrians, three YOLOv8x seeds); AUC treats ties as one half, and confidence intervals use 2,000 bootstrap resamples of pedestrians (of frames on CARLA). Scripts reproducing every number in the paper are released with it.
blocks.zh: KITTI分为5,236/1,122/1,123和CityPersons 2,432/521/522,用于列车/验证/测试. 在报告信任间隔的每个配置中,都使用3个种子;在表6中,单种子结果被标记为 +\dagger,使总共81个检查站得到评价。 所有装有 SGD (lr0 0013, lrf 0.123,重量衰减 0.054)的型号列车,为150个世纪,分批大小为32,耐心为20,为640 px. Occulation扩容只在训练期间使用,并且只有当超过半数的地真行人仍然可见时才使用. 深度 Anything V2 的度量输出被剪接到 0–80 m. 隔离分数通过1,941个匹配KITTI测试检测(682行人,3个YOLOv8x种子);AUC将领带作一半,信任间隔使用2,000个行人(CARLA上帧)的靴子后缀. 文稿再现出纸上每一个数字,随同发行.

blocks.en: Appendix H Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录H 限制

blocks.en: What is validated. The signal is validated as a ranking of occlusion presence and a coarse category (partly, heavily) against KITTI’s discrete labels, and against one visibility threshold on CARLA; it is not a continuous estimator of occlusion fraction. Evaluation covers pedestrians in daytime imagery only, not other object classes, whose size is far less standardized than human stature.
blocks.zh: 证明什么? 该信号被验证为对隐蔽存在的排名和粗细的类别(部分严重),与KITTI的离散标签和CARLA上的一个能见度阈值相对;它并不是对隐蔽分数的连续估计. 评估只涵盖白天图像中的行人,而不包括其他物体类,其大小远不如人的地位标准化.

blocks.en: Detector dependence. The apparent-height assumption holds for predicted boxes at the median but fails in a tail of low-confidence, heavily occluded detections, and the detector misses 27% of largely occluded pedestrians outright. A detector that systematically shrinks occluded boxes would weaken the signal, and should be checked the same way before deployment.
blocks.zh: 探测器依赖。 表面高度的假设对中位数的预测箱是持有的,但是在低自信的尾巴上失败了,严重被占用的探测器完全错过了27%基本上被占用的行人. 系统收缩被吞噬的盒子的探测器会削弱信号,在部署前应同样检查.

blocks.en: Depth model and camera. Calibration-free ranking holds only when depth error is close to a pure gain over the operating range. It held on KITTI with the outdoor checkpoint, but not with the indoor checkpoint at robot height on CARLA. On our own real-road robot recording, with the outdoor checkpoint at 0.186 m, a thresholded version of the score did no better at its operating point than flagging the smallest boxes. A new depth model, mounting height, or set of camera intrinsics must be checked, for example with the label-free correlation of Appendix B , not assumed.
blocks.zh: 深度模型和相机. 无校正排名仅当深度误差接近操作范围纯增益时才维持. 它在KITTI上设有室外检查站,但在CARLA上的机器人高度上却未设有室内检查站。 在我们自己的真道机器人录制中,户外检查站为0.186米,一个阈值版的分数在其操作点没有比标出最小的盒子更好的. 必须检查一个新的深度模型、升起高度或相机的一组内在相机,例如附录B的无标签关联,而不是假设。

blocks.en: Untested conditions. We have not evaluated the score in dense crowds, where several people share one box’s nearest surface; at night or in rain; with other monocular depth models; or on embedded hardware. The score cannot distinguish an occluder from any other nearer surface inside the box. The Lagos evaluation measures detector transfer, not the score, because the Lagos annotations have no occlusion labels; labelling occlusion there is the most direct next test of the claim this paper is motivated by.
blocks.zh: 未审条件. 我们没有在密集的人群中评估得分,在人群中,几个人共享一个盒子最近的表面;在夜晚或雨中;与其他单人深度模型;或嵌入式硬件。 得分无法区分占有者与盒子内任何其他更接近的表面. 拉各斯评估测量探测器的转移,而不是分数,因为拉各斯说明书没有隔离标签;标签隔离是本文所激发的主张最直接的下一个检验标准。
